item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 02:37 PM 24 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Capiz(Pontevedra, PresidentRoxas, Pilar) and #Iloilo(Carles) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Panay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
